title.en: Chapter 11 — The Iron in the Fire

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: قلت للباقيين: لازم نعمل إشي الليلة.
sentences.en: I said to the others: we have to do something tonight.

sentences.ar: لقينا حديد طويل بالقصر وحطيناه بالنار.
sentences.en: We found a long iron rod in the palace and put it in the fire.

sentences.ar: لما نام العملاق، قربنا منه بهدوء.
sentences.en: When the giant slept, we came near him quietly.
The sound of his breathing was like thunder.
We used the iron and fled to the shore.

sentences.ar: كنا عاملين طوافة من خشب من قبل.
sentences.en: We had made a raft from wood beforehand.
We pushed it into the water and got on it.
